component.name: Photocure
component.summary: Intelligent, local photo curation and cull assistant

description.p: Photocure is a standalone, privacy-first photo curation tool that runs entirely on your computer. It analyzes your photo library to identify duplicates, burst sequences, blinking subjects, quality issues, and helps you organize and cull your collection efficiently.

ul.li: Zero network requests; all processing happens locally

description.p: Fix prototype feedback bias in learning from corrections, add jewelry and cosmetics prompts to Product category, and protect non-matching photos from prototype hijacking.
Stage-aware burst counts across overview and sidebar, visual progress feedback and loader card during burst finalization, and graceful lock acquisition timeout.
Support Finalize All bursts directly from the top toolbar to move all marked-for-delete burst frames to trash and finalize all kept frames in one click.
Support finalizing individual bursts separately with automatic staging of marked-for-delete frames directly to the trash.
Ensure photos with faces are never routed to junk categories, protecting portraits in low-light, soft focus, and near-duplicate scenarios.

One library folder for every finished photo, and a clear New, Library and Trash switch. Trash keeps removed photos until you empty it, with restore, return to origin and reanalyse. A first-run popup asks for the library folder and device, and the whole library can be moved to another folder later.
Compare all burst faces in one shot with matrix view, robust spatial tracking across camera pans, and direct per-row curation controls.
Redesigned face inspection overlay with frosted tinted blur, subtle entrance animations, improved high-resolution thumbnails, and refined burst curation.
Choose the best shot in a burst, approve deletions photo by photo or all at once before analyzing, and the GPU is freed as soon as analysis finishes.
Redesigned interface in blue, pink and amber, a simpler import flow where Analyze also groups and sorts, and a clearer duplicates page.
Initial development release with burst detection, blink flagging, and hardlink organization.
